description: This file defines the 'MismatchedRangeException' class which extends RecognitionException. It models a specific exception used in parsing or recognition tasks, indicating a mismatch within a range. The class includes properties for the mismatched range boundaries and methods for initialization and string representation.

classes.name: MismatchedRangeException
classes.description: An exception class used to indicate a range mismatch in recognition or parsing processes. It stores the boundary values of the range that was mismatched.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with range boundaries and input context.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the exception, indicating the range that was mismatched.
